invariants.rationale: loadSync returns a TiledMap stored in 'map', which should be instantiated successfully to be returned.
If parameter is not null, its fields for texture filters are accessed, so they must also be non-null.
fileName is always required to reference the resource being loaded.
file is used to load the TiledMap and must not be null when loadSync completes.
AssetManager is needed for asset loading and is always present when this point is reached.
